source_evidence: Exact player 'ok then let’s get out of here' authorizes leaving the inspected refuge and continuing the already chosen western crossing journey. At Day331~11:10 V/Cirren/Fenar return to Mara and stopped coach on same road. Mara cautiously inspects continuing cartway and passes its actual traversable seven rough miles without damage or hired staging; no further random occurrence roll because D331 day already triggered and 2/2 leg cap used. Complete final7 rough route miles at ordinary difficult-ground pace (total12 rough miles today, 48 prior road miles, total60 route miles; approximately8h actual moving across entire day plus inspection/encounter/brief halt, no forced march). Charge full D331 provisions once, 3 carried rations15→12 and 4 feed20→16, same standing per-day accounting; no paid lodging, guide, ferry, horse/coach injury or purchase. Arrive Day331~16:20 at western Ossent's old service-house crossing in prep/dm-only/dm-estate-ancestry.md @f4b7f371448c8ef2d2b5f3c3467ac843b8b0f291. Visible ~50ft local freshwater stream, original collapsed stone bridge/rocky abutment, later timber ferry landing and short sheltered return eddy, occupied ferrier dwelling; no main river navigation or tidal assumption. Cartway widens on near bank; Mara halts coach/team on firm approach without entering the foot/pack/livestock landing, no agreed private staging or ferry use. Newly introduced actual ferrier Hessa Marr (middle-aged woman, practical working clothes, weathered, uses household's landing) is working on a mooring rope, approaches from landing, asks whether visitors seek crossing or old stonework; NPC interest in preserving livelihood and safe access, not secretly affiliated or automatic subordinate. No fee, labor, accommodation, agreement, grant presentation, ferrier rights change, site entry, undead confrontation, puzzle interaction, evidence collection, title transfer, recovery of salvage, commission earning or new quest acceptance. V next action. Ordinary travel and unobstructed arrival/contact do not require a further RNG draw. Earlier rest, combat, recovered Galepierce, resources and custody unchanged, LR0/6; no subsequent rest or night yet.
